name: SocialNotify: Notifications for Contact Form 7
author: ECA Tech Inc

sections.description:
SocialNotify Contact Form 7 is a WordPress plugin that integrates Twilio WhatsApp messaging with Contact Form 7. This plugin allows admins and users to receive WhatsApp notifications upon form submission. The plugin enables flexible configuration options, including message templates, admin/user notifications, and phone number settings.

Features:
– Seamless integration with Contact Form 7.
– Sends WhatsApp messages using Twilio API upon form submission.
– Allows both admin and user notifications.
– Supports custom message templates.
– Error logging for troubleshooting message delivery failures.
– Easy-to-use settings interface in the WordPress admin panel.

Requirements:
– WordPress Version: 5.0 or higher
– PHP Version: 7.4 or higher
– Contact Form 7: Must be installed and active.
– Twilio API Credentials: Required for sending WhatsApp messages.

Licensing

This plugin is released under the GPL-2.0+ license, making it free to use and modify.

Additional Information

  • Developer: Ecacode Team
  • Website: https://ecacode.com
  • Support Email: support@ecacode.com

External Services

This plugin uses the IP location API from ipapi.co to detect the user’s country.
This is used to prefill the phone input field with the appropriate country code.

Data Sent:
– User IP address (used to determine location)

This request is made client-side via JavaScript.

Service Provider: ipapi
– Terms: https://ipapi.co/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://ipapi.co/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to Settings > SocialNotify Contact Form 7 to configure Twilio credentials and message templates.
  6. Go to Contact Form 7 > Edit Form > SocialNotify Panel to configure individual form notifications.
